// A dense narrow-band signed-distance raster
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Signed_distance_function): negative inside,
// positive outside, in world units. Cells farther from the surface than
// NarrowBandWidth hold BackgroundDistance with the correct sign.
type LevelSetGrid3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Distances: Array3D<Number>;
    NarrowBandWidth: Number;
    BackgroundDistance: Number;
}
